name: taskrail
description: Lightweight AI-first automation framework with reusable components, governed capabilities, safe deployment, supervision, rollback, and agent skills.

scripts.fault:contract: npm run build && node --test dist/test/modular-hardening.test.js dist/test/modular-architecture.test.js
scripts.check: npm run build && node dist/src/taskrail-cli.js --help && node dist/src/taskrail-cli.js components && node dist/src/taskrail-cli.js agent describe && node dist/src/taskrail-cli.js diagnostics preview --message check && node dist/src/taskrail-cli.js security audit --strict --root src && node dist/src/supervise-cli.js --help && node dist/src/heartbeat-cli.js --help && node dist/src/systemd-cli.js --help && node -e "Promise.all([import('taskrail/components'), import('taskrail/capabilities'), import('taskrail/manifest'), import('taskrail/testing'), import('taskrail/control'), import('taskrail/agent'), import('taskrail/platform')]).then(([components, capabilities, manifest, testing, control, agent, platform]) => { if (!components.http || !components.config || !capabilities.buildUsageGraph || !manifest.validateConfig || !testing.evaluateConformance || !testing.certifyTaskRail || !testing.ValidationRegistry || !testing.createTaskRailValidationRegistry || !testing.SecurityRegistry || !testing.createTaskRailSecurityRegistry || !testing.assessPerformanceBudget || !testing.assessBackwardCompatibility || !control.LifecycleBus || !control.transactionalDeploy || !control.verifyProvenance || !control.assessSharedArtifactUpdate || !control.planRebootRecovery || !control.planRetention || !agent.agentActions || !agent.createDiagnosticReport || !agent.createAgentGrant || !platform.PlatformEventBus || !platform.PlatformCommandGateway || !platform.RunawayExecutionGuard) process.exit(1) })"
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm test && npm run check
